brief: A distinctive editorial copy-adaptation emblem: TWO large sculpted quotation-mark forms, one deep magenta and one soft blush, face one another around a single broad lavender fountain-pen nib. The pen nib bridges the two voices, showing a message being carefully rewritten for a different audience and cultural tone. Integrate the forms into one confident balanced silhouette with generous negative space. The quote forms should have a graceful calligraphic curvature without forming Arabic letters. Magenta #782859, blush #F9DAE0, lavender #D6B0FC, tiny warm-ivory nib slit. No megaphone, flower, book stack, document checklist, chat bubble, alphabetic text, flags or approval marks. Broad minimal surfaces; readable at48px.
